original_model_run_status: stopped_unknown_usage; no further application calls or retry authorized

methodological_basis.explicit_stop: critical_stops[0] and budgets.token_overshoot stop further application invocations. The ledger contract governs global application-invocation accounting; no separate global external-acquisition tool stop was declared.
methodological_basis.new_scope: This separately declared acquisition-only sideprobe is not the planned model-search phase, an application-planner substitute or continuation of the stopped processor trial. It preserves original stop/failure records and consumes only the original external acquisition allowance.
methodological_basis.authorization: Existing targeted-search/first-trial request plus explicit root coordination; no new application model budget.

source_seed.body_sufficiency: headline and photo credit only; no substantive protest details established

query_author.research_budget: Charged to existing six aggregate active agent-hours / one working day; tokens and cost unknown.

tool_caps.provider_internal_requests_retries_token: unknown; caps cover controller-visible requested operations only

clock.timeout_enforcement: Runtime cancellation unavailable/unknown; target is not a hard limit. Check remaining original/stage time before each call; if response returns after either deadline retain it and stop. No new clock/reset.

execution.single_operation_only: Each tool call contains exactly one search_query item or one open URL. No grouped operations, follow-links, find, screenshots, inferred URL requests or retry.
execution.fetch_rule: First fetch the exact frozen seed URL. Then scan explicit top-level search-result URLs in query order and returned rank, removing fragments only. Select the first at most two unique valid HTTP(S) URLs excluding the seed and already selected normalized URLs; no model/manual reranking, URL guessing or substitution after failure. Log malformed/non-HTTP(S)/duplicate skips. Never treat links inside snippets as separate ranked results.
execution.selected_fetch_receipts: Before each additional fetch, save an immutable {url,reason} request and selection receipt pointing to query event, returned rank and raw payload pin. This applies the frozen rule; it does not add an adaptive query.

recording.text: Real returned source text stays ignored under .news. Admit only successful fetched text preserved unchanged from the raw return; retain full/excerpt/truncated/unknown status. Search hits/snippets remain leads, never source observations.
recording.time: Record actual request/result observed times; source publication and original capture remain separate. Current search is not historical search.
recording.failures: Empty/failed/blocked/unattempted are not negative evidence; each dispatched failed attempt consumes its slot. Unfinished receipt or failed capture stops collection.

pre_dispatch_checks: Verify all frozen plan/request/source/recorder/prior receipt hashes.
Record root execution receipt under a new acquisition-only name with original clock and prior tool counts; no original run file is overwritten.
Confirm prior external search/fetch attempts are zero or deduct them from the same2/3allowance. Any inconsistent tool ledger blocks dispatch.
Unknown original application usage remains unknown and all application invocations remain blocked.
Stop if original deadline or sideprobe deadline elapsed; no unspent slots transfer elsewhere.
expected_limits: This can establish exact controller-visible acquisition/recording behavior and failures only.
No application planner, D/E reconstruction, paired model comparison, source quality/importance, complete coverage or useful-news claim is measured.
No source fact, correction, counterevidence or subsequent development is required to exist or to be returned.
If fetched sources are admitted, later source-only labeling must precede any future candidate output under a separately bounded authorized plan; no candidate output is authorized here.
